one_line: Put the book in the parent's hands in the first second, with the gift promise as text at 0:00.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a mostly black frame with a small tilted clip of a mother and daughter; by 0:02 it fills the screen and she holds up a book. Subtitle and voice (transcript): "רציתי לתת ל[child's name] שלי מתנה שתשאר איתה לתמיד".
q1_hook.why: A gift that lasts is a clear emotional promise, said and subtitled from 0:00 (H1, H6), and the book is held up by 0:02 (S1). The first second is a small tilted clip on black with a white border, not a large readable frame (H7). "What gift?" is answered fast, so little curiosity builds (H5).

beats.what: Small tilted clip on black, subtitle "רציתי לתת ... מתנה שתשאר איתה לתמיד"
beats.why: States the promise before the picture is full screen

beats.what: Mother shows the cover; the girl smiles and leans in; both read; "משהו שיראה לה כמה היא מיוחדת"
beats.why: The real reaction, the most credible moment, comes first

beats.what: Sparkle transition to hands-only page close-ups (girl with a unicorn, a fairy by a stream)
beats.why: Shows the story pages; the line about her eyes lighting up plays here

beats.what: Black frame, back to the bed; "אומץ וביטחון", "ספר מותאם אישית הוא לא עוד צעצוע"
beats.why: Returns to the live moment for the benefit lines

beats.what: White frame, night-scene spread, a page turn; "הוא מעניק לילדים תחושה שהם יכולים לעשות הכל!"
beats.why: More pages under a claim about confidence

beats.what: Last page: "נוצר באהבה", FunSome logo, QR code, an illustrated mother reading with a girl

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: "רוצים ליצור ספר אישי לילדים שלכם?", a yes/no question leading into the link ask. A gift framing exists, but nothing names a person to send it to.
q2_flow.why: The real mother-and-child moment at 0:02 to 0:08 is the strongest part (K8, K1). The reaction line ("her eyes lit up") comes later over hands-only pages after a sparkle transition, so words and face are apart (R3, E2). The middle is claims over similar page shots, and it ends on a brand page, not a payoff (R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. A printed QR code and logo on the last page (0:31-0:32) are part of the book. Caption: "רוצים ליצור ספר אישי לילדים שלכם? היכנסו לקישור בביו לפרטים והזמנה 🔗".
q3_cta.why: One action, link in bio, stated plainly in the caption (C1). But it is not said or shown in the video, and the caption opens with a feeling, not the ask (C6). A viewer convinced at 0:32 gets a QR code that cannot be scanned on the same phone.

q4_shown.what: The cover held up 0:01-0:03; the girl's reaction 0:02-0:08; page close-ups of an illustrated girl with a unicorn 0:09-0:17 and 0:25-0:30; mother and girl turning pages 0:19-0:23; last page with logo and QR code 0:31. No price, no screen recording.
q4_shown.why: The book is in hand from 0:01 (S1). The child's reaction is real and her name is on the cover title, but no real photo sits beside an illustrated page (S2). Personalising is told, not shown (S8). A mother vouches in generic words (S6). A child's face with her name is what LumeBook avoids (S5).

q5_edit.what: A tilted photo-frame intro, then 5 shots averaging 6.5 s, with a sparkle overlay at 0:09, a black frame at 0:18 and a white frame at 0:24. Phrase-by-phrase two-line subtitles synced to the voiceover. No speed changes. Ends on the last page.
q5_edit.why: Movement and text from frame one meet the 3 s test (E1). Effect transitions and a sparkle overlay cut away from the child's face just as the voice describes her reaction (E2). Page close-ups of similar content run 4 to 9 s (R3). Voice with synced text works muted (E4).

q6_topic.what: A mother's gift to her daughter: a personalised unicorn and fairy adventure that makes the child the hero. Serves parents looking for a gift that lasts.
q6_topic.why: A gift framing with a parent as buyer, but no occasion is named (K7). The child's delight is the warm moment (K1). Claims such as "gives children the feeling they can do anything" are broad, not modest or checkable (K4). Parents can send a gift idea to a person (R5).

q7_filmed.what: A static eye-level two-shot of mother and girl on a bed in warm indoor light; handheld high-angle close-ups of the open book on a patterned bedspread with a hand on the page; a light-ray overlay on the close-ups.
q7_filmed.why: A home bed scene looks native and intimate (H8, F7). The two-shot shows the real faces (K8). Close-ups fill the frame with the illustration (F4), with a hand in contact (F5), but the overlay and the bedspread pattern make the page busy.

q8_text.on_screen: White subtitles with a soft shadow, two lines, centred about 78% down, phrase by phrase: "רציתי לתת ל[child's name] שלי מתנה שתשאר איתה לתמיד" (0:00), "העיניים שלה פשוט נדלקו" (0:11), "ספר מותאם אישית הוא לא עוד צעצוע" (0:21), "כי בסוף החוויות הכי יפות שלנו יחד נחרטות בלב" (0:28). Last page print: "נוצר באהבה". No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "המתנה הכי מרגשת שנתתי ל[child's name] שלי ❤️". About 50 words: a feeling line, a benefit line, a question with the link ask, "בשיתוף @funsomeil", then hashtags.
q8_text.why: Subtitles of the whole voice let a muted viewer follow (T1), but they are near a transcript (T2) and sit over bright, busy pages in the bottom 35% (T4, T5). The caption has search words and hashtags (T7). The disclosure sits at the end, below "more" (T8).

weak_points: Generic read-out script; flash and sparkle transitions over the key line; small tilted intro on black; claim lines over similar pages; disclosure only at the end of the caption; the child's face with her name; no ask in the video.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a hands-only reading on a bed: top-down cover and pages, one page held steady for 2 s, and put the caption's one ask on the last frame.
not_verified: Whether the voice is the creator's. Music and natural sound are not evident. Machine transcript mishears several words, so subtitles were read from the frames. The web address on the last page is cut off. Corrections to src/coded: the cover is held up from 0:01, not 2.0 s; the child's name is on the small cover title at 0:02, not clearly visible. One caption hashtag ("מתנהמיוחדת") has no # sign. Whether the post was paid beyond the caption words.
